pairs.registryProposal: adoption-lifecycle says a non-transactional step must surface as an explicit incomplete-adoption state, but unlike readiness-prerequisites (degraded adoption must be durable on the instance) it does not say whether that state must outlive the flow. Here the partial team is explicit inside the modal (retry holds the result in hook state) and nothing marks the team incomplete once the modal closes. Composite templates (a team of N adopted members) would benefit from the same durability rule stated for incomplete adoption.
